description: Look up specific figures stated on Digital in Asia (about 7,700 sourced data points across Asia's digital economy): market sizes, internet and smartphone users, ecommerce GMV, wallet users, market shares, revenue, funding and valuations, AI and gaming market sizes, policy budgets. Each figure comes with its period, the original source (publisher, date, link) and the DIA pages that use it. Most recent periods first.

market.description: Optional: limit to one market or company name, e.g. "Indonesia" or "GCash"

period.description: Optional: a year or period, e.g. "2025"

query.description: What you want, e.g. "Vietnam internet users", "Shopee GMV", "India UPI transactions", "China AI market size"

name: get_figures
title: Get DIA figures
